# Spectrum Design Data

> Adobe's Spectrum design system source of truth: design tokens, the Design Data Specification, component schemas, SDK, CLI, and MCP servers. Spectrum 2 lives on `main`; Spectrum 1 lives on the `s1-legacy` branch.

This repository is a pnpm and moon monorepo (ES modules, Node.js, plus a Rust SDK). It mixes products for Spectrum users with maintainer tooling. This file indexes the resources meant for external use; each package below publishes its own `llms.txt`.

## Packages with their own llms.txt

- [packages/component-schemas](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/packages/component-schemas/llms.txt): JSON Schemas describing Spectrum component APIs and options.
- [packages/design-data](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/packages/design-data/llms.txt): Canonical Spectrum design token data in cascade format, plus components, fields, registry, and guidelines.
- [packages/design-data-spec](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/packages/design-data-spec/llms.txt): Design Data Specification: prose, JSON Schemas, rule catalog, and conformance fixtures.
- [packages/tokens](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/packages/tokens/llms.txt): Generated legacy output of Spectrum design tokens, published to npm. Source of truth is packages/design-data.
- [sdk/wasm](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/wasm/llms.txt): WebAssembly bindings for design-data-core.
- [tools/component-diff-generator](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/component-diff-generator/llms.txt): Diff reports for component schema changes with breaking-change analysis.
- [tools/design-data](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/design-data/llms.txt): Node.js helpers for the WASM package: dataset loading, token writes, authoring sessions.
- [tools/design-data-agent-mcp](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/design-data-agent-mcp/llms.txt): MCP server and Claude Code skill for design-data authoring sessions.
- [tools/design-data-mcp](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/design-data-mcp/llms.txt): Embedded, offline MCP server for tokens, component schemas, and guidelines.
- [tools/design-data-skill](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/design-data-skill/llms.txt): Claude Code skill for querying Spectrum design data through the CLI.
- [tools/diff-generator](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/diff-generator/llms.txt): Token diff CLI and library with CLI, JSON, and Markdown output.
- [tools/optimized-diff](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/optimized-diff/llms.txt): High-performance deep object diff library.
- [tools/s2-docs-mcp](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/s2-docs-mcp/llms.txt): MCP server for Spectrum 2 documentation.
- [tools/spectrum-diff-core](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/tools/spectrum-diff-core/llms.txt): Shared core library for the diff generators.

## Other consumer-facing resources

- [sdk](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk): Rust workspace for the design-data SDK (CLI, core, TUI, WASM, plugins).
- [sdk/cli](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/cli): The `design-data` command-line interface.
- [sdk/core](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/core): Core library: token resolution, validation, registry, and diffing.
- [sdk/plugins/dtcg](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/plugins/dtcg): DTCG import and export plugin.
- [sdk/plugins/figma](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/plugins/figma): Figma variables import, export, and diff plugin.
- [sdk/plugins/site](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/plugins/site): Static component explorer site generator.
- [sdk/plugins/site/assets](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/plugins/site/assets): Browser assets (HTML and visual runtime) embedded by the site generator.
- [sdk/plugins/site/controls](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/plugins/site/controls): Build script and pinned lockfile for the Spectrum Web Components bundle in assets/.
- [sdk/tui](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/sdk/tui): Interactive terminal UI for authoring and inspecting design data.
- [platforms](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/platforms): Incubating platform manifests for implementation teams.
- [docs/release-timeline](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/docs/release-timeline): Interactive timeline of Spectrum token releases.
- [docs/s2-docs](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/docs/s2-docs): Spectrum 2 documentation content mirrored from Spectrum Hub.
- [docs/s2-tokens-viewer](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/docs/s2-tokens-viewer): Spectrum 2 tokens viewer web app.
- [docs/s2-visualizer](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/docs/s2-visualizer): Spectrum 2 token visualizer web app.
- [docs/site](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/docs/site): Eleventy docs site for Spectrum Design Data.
- [docs/visualizer](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/docs/visualizer): Spectrum 1 token visualizer, still deployed as a static site. Relationship to the S2 viewer is unverified.

## Maintainer-only tooling

The 17 maintainer tools (release, taxonomy, authoring, and sync utilities) are not intended for Spectrum users, even when published to npm. They are listed in the [repository index](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/docs/repo-index.md).

- [Repository index](https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-design-data/blob/main/docs/repo-index.md): audience, lifecycle, and publication status for every project

- Deprecated, kept for compatibility: `packages/design-system-registry`, `tools/spectrum-design-data-mcp`
